title: Welsh Cakes (Picau ar y Maen — 'Cakes on a Stone')
story: Welsh cakes (called 'picau ar y maen', or 'cakes on a stone' in Welsh) are a traditional snack, popular in Wales. My grandparents spoke Welsh, grew up in a small Ohio town named after a Welsh county, and led a Welsh choir every year for an annual festival called the cymanfa ganu. These scone-like griddle cakes are frequently served as a snack with tea or sometimes with breakfast on special days, and it holds the same place for Welsh children that chocolate chip cookies and milk do for American kids. For me, when I was young, I stayed with my grandparents frequently since both my parents worked, and always looked forward to a fresh plate of these little guys waiting for my cousin and I after school on Friday to celebrate surviving another week.
